account.signOutMessage: This ends your DHBW Cloud session and takes you back to the sign-in page. Your bwIDM single sign-on session stays active, so signing in again may not ask for a password. To end that session as well, close your browser.

errorBoundary.title: Something went wrong

dnsValidation.labelTooLong: Each label may be at most 63 characters, this one has {{length}}.
dnsValidation.lowercaseOnly: Only lowercase letters, digits and hyphens are allowed.
dnsValidation.hyphenEdge: A label must not start or end with a hyphen.
dnsValidation.nameTooLong: The full name has {{length}} characters, at most 253 are allowed.
dnsValidation.nameCharacters: Only letters, digits, hyphen and underscore are allowed.

principalSearch.placeholder: Group or email address, e.g. wwi24 or doe@
principalSearch.syntax: Finds groups by id, name and description, and people by part of their email address – people only once they are in some group. Several words must all occur; OR joins alternatives (mannheim OR karlsruhe). "…" finds exactly that phrase, * stands for any characters. Groups with roles also appear as group#role, e.g. standort-ma#beschaeftigte: only the people holding that role.
principalSearch.unreachable: The group directory is not reachable — no suggestions. You can still type a token by hand.

session.title: Your session has expired
session.message: You have been signed out, so nothing on this page can be saved or reloaded until you sign in again. Signing in reloads the page and brings you back here — copy anything you have typed before you do.

swagger.client: A generated TypeScript client is published as <1><2>{{package}}</2></1>; its version matches the API version shown above. Install it with <3>{{install}}</3>.

app.signInMessage: Please sign in to access and manage your DNS zones and cloud resources.

signInOutage.title: Signing in is currently unavailable
signInOutage.message: The university's sign-in service is not responding. If you are signed in, you can keep working. A new sign-in will only work again once the service is back — nothing needs to be done on your side.

actAs.title: Act on behalf of a person
actAs.explain: Every service (cloud, DNS, AI) then shows and does what this person sees and does. The project history also names you. Applies to this tab only.
actAs.searchPlaceholder: Search a person, or type any email…
actAs.noMatch: No match — a full email address works anyway.
actAs.bannerExplain: Everything on these pages happens in this person's name and with their rights. Chat and JupyterHub still open with your own sign-in.
actAs.refused: Not in effect at: {{services}} (no admin rights there).
